page_title: WER 2-0 HEI | Werder Bremen v Heidenheim 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' 2 - 0 What an unlucky own goal by Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim)!
90+7' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) gets the ball from a rebound and thumps a terrific long-range shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, it sails narrowly wide of the right post. Unlucky finish.
90+6' A cross into the box from Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim) is cleared.
90+5' The attendance for today's match is 40000.
90+3' A crossfield pass from Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
90+3' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle. Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+2' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar.
90+2' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Here is a change. Romano Schmid is going off and Daniel Thioune gives the last tactical orders to Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
89' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Julian Malatini.
88' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
87' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the left post.
85' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Florian Badstubner who sees an offensive foul.
84' Leonidas Stergiou (Heidenheim) sends a long ball in, but Mio Backhaus comfortably gathers the ball.
81' A cross from Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
81' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
80' The substitution is prepared. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marco Grull.
79' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) sends it out of play.
78' What a chance that is! Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar.
76' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
74' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) replacing Benedikt Gimber.

74' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks accuracy and flies well over the crossbar.
74' It seemed like Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
72' The foul by Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Florian Badstubner.

71' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Frank Feller!
69' Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Keke Topp replaces him.
68' Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
65' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Jan Schoppner and he is replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
65' A substitution has been made. Eren Dinkci goes off and Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) comes on.
64' Leonidas Stergiou (Heidenheim) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

63' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at Frank Feller, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him.
60' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle and it's Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

57' 1 - 0 Romano Schmid showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom right corner. It's 1:0.
56' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
56' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) switches the play to Cameron Puertas and their attacking move continues.
54' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
52' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle as Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
50' A cross into the box picks out Leonidas Stergiou (Heidenheim), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar.
49' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Frank Schmidt probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim). He is replaced by Leonidas Stergiou.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) is replaced by Stefan Schimmer.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Florian Badstubner has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' A player from Heidenheim commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
45+2' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball, though, only brushes the left post.
45+1' The ball is cleared after Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
41' That was close by Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
40' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
37' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the right post. He should have scored!
36' Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post.
34' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
33' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim).
32' A raking crossfield pass from Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
31' Frank Feller is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen). Easy save!
30' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
29' The goal by Werder Bremen is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
27' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Werder Bremen players aren’t happy.
27' Goal! Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
23' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
22' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Mio Backhaus.
21' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Florian Badstubner blows for a foul.
19' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
17' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
17' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
16' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Werder Bremen force their opponents to concede a corner.
15' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
12' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) dribbles into the box, but Frank Feller is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
10' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) commits a foul and Florian Badstubner immediately signals a free kick.
9' A pass from Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) is intercepted by Frank Feller and the move breaks down.
7' A player from Heidenheim commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
6' Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
6' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
3' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

3' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. It will be a corner kick for Werder Bremen.
3' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
